topics.name: Image Retrieval & Visual Search
topics.description: The core topic: every paper that names image retrieval in its title or abstract, plus image search, similarity search, and near-duplicate or copy detection.

topics.name: Instance-Level & Landmark Retrieval
topics.description: Finding the same object or place instance: landmark and particular-object retrieval, local and global descriptors, re-ranking and spatial verification.

topics.name: Image-Text & Cross-Modal Retrieval
topics.description: Retrieving images with language and vice versa: image-text matching, text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval, and vision-language retrieval.

topics.name: Composed & Interactive Image Retrieval
topics.description: Retrieval with multimodal queries such as a reference image plus modification text, including zero-shot CIR, text feedback and dialog-based search.

topics.name: Sketch-Based Image Retrieval
topics.description: Retrieving photos, videos or 3D shapes from free-hand sketches: category-level, fine-grained and zero-shot SBIR.

topics.name: Fine-Grained Retrieval & Metric Learning
topics.description: Learning discriminative embeddings for retrieval: deep metric learning objectives and fine-grained image retrieval.

topics.name: Hashing & Efficient Retrieval
topics.description: Compact codes and fast search for large-scale retrieval: deep and cross-modal hashing, quantization and approximate nearest-neighbor search.

topics.name: Person & Object Re-Identification
topics.description: Re-identification and person search framed as retrieval: person, vehicle, animal and object re-ID, and text-based person retrieval.

topics.name: Visual Place Recognition & Geo-Localization
topics.description: Image-based localization through retrieval: visual place recognition, cross-view and image geo-localization.

topics.name: Video & Text-Video Retrieval
topics.description: Searching video collections: text-to-video retrieval, video moment retrieval, content-based video retrieval and video copy detection.

topics.name: Multimodal Embeddings & Universal Retrieval
topics.description: General-purpose embedding models for search across images and text: universal multimodal retrieval and MLLM-based embedders.

topics.name: Visual Document Retrieval & Multimodal RAG
topics.description: Retrieval over visually rich documents and retrieval-augmented generation with images: visual document retrieval and multimodal RAG.

topics.name: Domain-Specific Image Retrieval
topics.description: Image retrieval in specialized domains: remote sensing, medical and histopathology images, fashion and products, art, trademarks, faces, food and 3D shapes.
